source.note: rare_chars rc3 (rare*.py, configs/rc3.json, tables/*_rare.npz, *_rcref.npz, rc3_gb.npz) was copied from the research working tree before it was committed; these are the files frozen by sha256 for rc3's one-shot holdout / external run (research runs/holdout_ledger.jsonl, 2026-10-22). rc4 (configs/rc4.json, tables/rc4_gb.npz, the gate / ref keys in rare.py and load_cats in rare_ref.py) is research commit 5118334, dev only. rc1t (configs/rc1t.json and tables/rc1t_ctx_*.npz) is the frozen token-only candidate in vllm_stability_monitor_evolution_aro_1030/deliverable_v2 (detector be54a279dd83fe38999cfb63d052a153ae7916a89027b618d43921c97559205f), not a release described by the research commit above; its online input and model contain no logprobs, while its static tables retain dev-trained state. The reference alerts in detector_v35/runs/rc1t_* came from that repo's uncommitted rc1t adapter working tree, not from the research commit above; the frozen 1030 detector and table hashes are the provenance anchor.
